meta.title: Spend meter
meta.description: Adds a standing row at the sidebar foot (above Settings): DeepSeek balance, today's estimated spend, today's input and output token counts, and whether peak or off-peak pricing applies right now with a countdown to the next switch, with no click required. Clicking the row opens today's spend details: the off-peak and peak split, a per-session breakdown (title, input and output tokens, cost), a per-model breakdown when several models were used, and a link to the DeepSeek platform billing page. An optional daily budget (off by default) warns at 90% and blocks DeepSeek model requests once the limit is reached, while other providers stay available. The full reading is also in the hover tooltip. The balance comes from the signed-in DeepSeek account. Today's spend is estimated from the token usage recorded in today's Harness sessions at the official DeepSeek price list, so usage billed outside this Harness is not included and non-DeepSeek models are counted but not priced. Peak hours are Monday to Friday 09:00-12:00 and 14:00-18:00 Beijing time; every other hour and all weekends are off-peak at half price. Public holidays are not built in: list them in the plugin's `holidays` config, otherwise the tooltip says so. Data refreshes about once a minute and only while a page is open. Note: the sidebar-foot seat is shared with the built-in Cordis panel button, so a running Cordis dynamic package can squeeze this row out.
